items.t: Championed, with House Democrats, affordability measures that the release says are delivering tax relief and returning $600 million to nearly one million working families.
items.q: Major affordability measures championed by Speaker Emanuel “Chris” Welch and House Democrats are now delivering tax relief and putting $600 million back in the pockets of nearly one million working families.

items.t: Led the effort to establish the Proviso Math and Science Academy while serving on the Proviso Township High School Board.
items.q: He served for 12 years on the Proviso Township High School Board and led the effort to establish the nationally recognized Proviso Math and Science Academy.

items.t: Supported Amendment 1, the workers' rights amendment, in 2022.
items.q: enshrines the right for unions to negotiate working conditions, something the speaker has said he supports, in the Constitution. Welch supported the Amendment in 2022.

record.t: Was elected Speaker of the Illinois House of Representatives, the first African American to lead the chamber.
record.q: the election of Rep. Emanuel “Chris” Welch as the newly elected Speaker of the 102nd General Assembly: “We witnessed history today when members of the Illinois House of Representatives elected the first African American to lead their chamber,”

record.t: Has served as State Representative from the 7th District of Illinois since 2013.
record.q: Emanuel “Chris” Welch has served as a State Representative from the 7th District of Illinois since 2013.

record.t: Served as Chair of the House Executive Committee and earlier chaired the Higher Education committee.
record.q: Welch served as Chair of the House Executive Committee and before that he Chaired Higher Education.

record.t: Delivered, with House Democrats, a back-to-school sales tax holiday, which the release says saved Illinois families more than $11 million.
record.q: Working families in Illinois saved more than $11 million on new clothes, shoes, and school supplies thanks to the recent back-to-school sales tax holiday delivered by Speaker Emanuel “Chris” Welch and House Democrats.

record.t: Discussed efforts to rebuild Illinois' fiscal house and cut the cost of living at the National Speakers Conference in South Carolina, and brought the gavel home for the 2027 conference in Chicago.
record.q: Speaker Emanuel “Chris” Welch discussed efforts to rebuild Illinois’ fiscal house and cut the cost of living with State House leaders from across the country at the National Speakers Conference last week in South Carolina.

record.t: Joined former U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi to celebrate 18 women who earned college degrees through the Northwestern Prison Education Program.
record.q: House Speaker Emanuel “Chris” Welch celebrated the first women to earn college degrees through the Northwestern Prison Education Program this week, joining former United States House Speaker Nancy Pelosi to honor 18 women
